title: Prompt timeout never fires: consola 3.2.3 ignores AbortSignal
description: promptWithTimeout in src/domain/download/track.js passes an AbortController signal to logger.prompt, but consola 3.2.3's bundled clack prompt implementation has no signal/abort support (verified: zero references in node_modules/consola/dist/chunks/prompt.mjs). The abort is silently ignored, so PROMPT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS does nothing and prompts block forever. Fix: on timeout, emit a synthetic 'return' keypress on process.stdin so the prompt submits its default/initial value.

title: Prompt timeout interrupts manual tag editing
description: The auto-continue timer keeps running after the user chooses 'Edit...' (artist), 'Custom URL...' (thumbnail), or starts typing in the free-text Title prompt. The synthetic Enter fires mid-edit and submits the default, discarding the user's input. Timer must not run on explicit edit paths, and must be cancelled once the user starts typing in a free-text prompt.
close_reason: Edit paths run without a timer; title prompt cancels its timer on first keypress

title: Add latinize command to transliterate Greek in filenames and ID3 tags
description: Previously-downloaded files under downloads/ have Greek names and Greek ID3 tags. Now that download paths transliterate to Latin (spoti3-14f), existing files no longer match and re-download. Need a command that scans a directory, renames files/folders and rewrites MP3 tags, replacing Greek characters with Latin counterparts.
acceptance_criteria: Recursive bottom-up scan; renames dirs and files; retags .mp3 title/artist/album/albumartist/genre/composer/comment; only touches strings containing Greek (no accent stripping of Latin text); skips on collision; --dry-run prints plan; tests pass; lint clean

title: Transliterate Greek characters to Latin for filenames and MP3 tags
description: Greek-titled tracks produce filenames and ID3 tags in Greek script. Add a greekToLatin() utility in src/utils/basic.js and apply it at the filename chokepoint (sanitizeFilename) and the tag/prompt chokepoint (getTrackMetadata), plus folderName at source and titleToFriendlyName. Must NOT touch searchTitle/getSearchTerm - YouTube search relies on native script.
acceptance_criteria: greekToLatin strips accents, maps final sigma, handles the 'ou' digraph, and preserves all-caps (THESSALONIKI not ThESSALONIKI); no Greek codepoints survive in output; function is idempotent; tests appended to src/utils/__tests__/basic.test.js; npm test and npm run lint pass

title: Add --yolo flag to mp3 command: skip all interactive prompts
description: Add -y/--yolo option to the mp3 command. When set, skip the download-folder prompt (src/domain/index.js confirmFolderName) and all track-metadata prompts (promptForTrackMetadata in src/domain/download/track.js), accepting the calculated values as-is.

title: Extract track information from Youtube description
Fix lint error: unused 'logger' import in src/services/spotify/index.js
description: npm run lint fails with one pre-existing error: 'logger' is defined but never used (src/services/spotify/index.js:2). Remove the unused import.
